last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Fri 09-11, back after a gap, and the hour handed me the sharpest finding of the campaign. FIRST THE COLLECTS. adhukku appuram LANDED - he got it into a story at home and the conversation kept going. Contact, not evidence: banked, nothing logged, stop nagging it. The plate op did NOT fire - vendaanga never came out. No shame taken, none given; that trigger recurs daily and the op stays loaded. THE FINDING, AND IT IS THE WHOLE SESSION: -nga HAS NO ADDRESS. Three asks, three wrong hosts - nandri-nga (09-10, onto a noun, and a bookish one at that), enna semayanga (onto a noun again), naalaiku sonnanga (onto a tail that points at OTHER PEOPLE, on a line about his own action). He has not failed to learn the ending. He has learned it too well and is spraying it at whatever word is nearest. The drill taught -nga; nothing ever taught it WHO it points at. That is the ESCALATE answer for respect-nga, and it is not another matched-pair loop - it is a decomposition of one verb and every tail it owns: -ren is me, -nga is you, -aanga is them. SECOND PATTERN, and it re-reads an old entry: THE -la DEFAULT. toongala today where thookkam varaadhu was wanted; ukarala on 09-05 where ukkaarunga was. I filed ukarala under respect-nga and that was only half of it. When he does not know which tail goes on the end his hand grabs -la, and -la always comes out meaning NO - so he keeps handing elders negatives he never meant. WHAT HE GOT RIGHT, TWICE. illavitta: I asked for the otherwise-hinge and he produced the formal twin of illannaa unaided. Not a miss - he owns the joint and picked the newsreader version. Do NOT log it cold and do not grade him against illannaa; teach the register, keep the word. And varaadhu - he asked what it was and then answered himself, is that like va. Yes: vaa, varum, varaadhu, found with no hint. DECOMPOSITION ON DEMAND IS TWO SESSIONS RUNNING AS HIS HIGHEST-YIELD MOVE AND HE IS THE ONE ASKING FOR IT. Feed it deliberately instead of waiting to be asked. It did NOT spend the ambush: he recognised vaa inside a word, he never produced vaanga. வா IS STILL HELD OUT OF EVERY PRODUCTION SLOT, the ambush is unspent, and it has to stay unannounced - do not fire it in a scene already saturated with -nga talk, because a primed hit is not evidence. SOAK ORDER: noun-for-verb, owed since 08-31, never commissioned, slipped a third time today. Episode lane by the error rule - he hears the difference fine, his mouth takes the noun, so the verb has to be seen doing work under load. TOMORROW OFFERED: the Deep-Dive - one root, every tail, who each tail points at. Low-power twin: the drill tape and the compound tape, both still unheard. TONIGHT: the positive twin of the plate op - whoever is serving stays on their feet while everyone eats, and the line is neenga saapdunga. Positive before negative, -nga on a verb, a trigger that house runs every single day. Collect it first next open.

soak_order.focus: THE VERB MUST FIRE AND THE NOUN IS THE TRAP. Build every beat so the lazy answer is the noun (samayal, kaapi, velai) and the line only works when the verb carries it (samaikkira, kudukkira, paakkira). Same root shown twice under load - once as the thing, once as the doing, close together, with the verb always the one that answers the question. Keep the endings OUT of the contrast: one axis only, do not permute the person or stack a -nga onto it. Never name a rule, never say noun or verb, never explain the difference. THIS BRIEF IS FOR YOU, NOT FOR HIM: say nothing in the intro, outro or any cue about what he got wrong, how often, or that this is a repair. No counts, no tally. He is doing reps, not reading a report.
